meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找编码助手的历史会话,还原此前做过什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要找回之前 AI 编程会话干了什么,避免重复劳动。
copy.tagline_en: Find past coding-agent sessions and see what was done before
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to recover what an earlier session did.

howto.what: Claude 会先搜索你电脑里保存的各种编程助手的会话记录，而不是凭记忆回答。它能按模糊回忆找到对应对话，并读取其中的任务内容与结果告诉你。
howto.when: 当你说要查找过去的会话记录、转录文本或子代理运行记录，或询问之前某次会话做过什么（比如“上个 bug 是怎么修的”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下上周修复登录报错的那次会话记录
say.note: 会搜索本地记录并返回相关会话摘要。

say.text: 搜索所有平台里提到“deploy”的会话
say.note: 会以“deploy”为关键词并行搜索各平台记录。

say.text: 列出近七天 Codex 的所有交互记录
say.note: 会限定平台和时间范围，列出匹配的会话。

howto.what_en: Claude first searches the locally stored session logs of coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.) instead of answering from memory, then reads the relevant entries to tell you what a past session did or which tasks it ran.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did — e.g., 'what did I work on recently' or 'did we already fix X'.

say_en.text: Find the session where I fixed the login error last week.
say_en.note: Searches local logs and returns a summary.

say_en.text: Search all platforms for sessions mentioning 'deploy'.
say_en.note: Runs a parallel keyword search across platforms.

say_en.text: List all Codex interactions from the last seven days.
say_en.note: Filters by platform and time window.
